[Aug 4, 2026](https://jitter.video/changelog/2026-08-04-2x-ai-generations/)


# 2× AI generations for everyone


Jitter AI now uses 50% fewer credits on every plan. Anything you build in the AI chat now costs half the credits it used to, so you can create twice as much without changing how you work.


Whether you're creating custom effects with a prompt, translating a new campaign into multiple languages, or adapting your designs to several sizes, your existing credit balance now goes double the distance.
